exam_name: Administering Relational Databases on Microsoft Azure
exam_price_notes: Check the official booking page for the price in your country or region.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.
target_audience: Database administrator who manages cloud and on-premises databases built with Azure SQL services and SQL Server.
recommended_experience: Experience with Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Managed Instance, SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines (Windows and Linux), and SQL Server on-premises.

prerequisites.description: Experience with building database solutions that support multiple workloads built with Azure SQL services and SQL Server.

retake_policy.notes: After the first failure, wait 24 hours. Wait 14 days between later attempts. At most five attempts in the 12 months starting with the first attempt; after five failures, wait until that period ends. Retake fees apply. See Microsoft's policy for exceptions.

study_actions.title: Atlas study exercise: Plan a database recovery review
study_actions.detail: Choose a database workload with a recovery requirement. Explain the backup and restore evidence you would check, then distinguish recovery planning from query-performance troubleshooting. Map your review to the availability, security and optimization objectives rather than memorizing isolated commands. This is a study aid, not an official exam question or a prediction of your result.
